candidate_source_binding: the explicit fused production-path plumbing, single-process campaign gate, source-set custody closure, runtime topology receipts, tests, and this predeclaration must be one non-merge commit directly above the baseline and pushed before the first fixed-campaign candidate call or production-topology performance sample
precommit_correctness_verification: non-timed compile, unit, integration, and explicit real-Metal bit-exact correctness tests are allowed before the campaign commit; their elapsed test-harness time is not read, recorded, selected, or used as performance evidence

primitive_authorization.scope: independent count-18 primitive only; authorizes this separate explicit full-path continuation gate, not an end-to-end or TPS claim and not default activation

scope.runtime_path: explicit Metal W8 MLP-to-Stack3 boundary plus fused tail-head v1

production_mapping.changed_scope: only the depthwise, Q/K normalization, recurrent update, and norm-gate core inside the initial Stack3 and each of five MLP-to-Stack3 boundary transactions
production_mapping.unchanged_scope: input/output projections, MLPs, residuals, full attention and KV, prefill, tail MLP/head, exact F32 rerank, state publication, host transfers, encoders, command buffers, commits and waits
production_mapping.retain_unused_processed_and_core_allocat: required for the first continuation screen so the persistent allocation ledger is not another experimental variable

precommitted_runtime_topology_per_decode.admission: live bridge receipts, model mechanism receipts, and recomputed aggregate ledgers must all match these exact counts; internal threadgroup barriers are separately attested and never counted as broad encoder barriers

single_process_fixed_campaign.teacher_order_rationale: C conservatively occupies the first system-wide Metal decode position so any residual driver cold-start cost works against, never in favor of, the candidate
single_process_fixed_campaign.failure_policy: after start admission and create-new campaign sentinel publication, stop at the first failed slot, publish a create-new partial raw receipt after end-custody attempt, reject, and never rerun this v1 campaign

changed_body_metric.per_arm_statistic: even median of the two A or two C teacher slot values

end_to_end_metric.field: profile.tpot_ms from the eight free candidate slots
end_to_end_metric.per_block_statistic: even median of two A values and even median of two C values
end_to_end_metric.pooled_statistic: even median of all four A values and even median of all four C values

effect_budget_not_a_claim.threshold_rationale: 3.0 percent body and 1.5 percent TPOT retain roughly half the first-order effect while staying materially above the old qk drift; these values are admission thresholds, not expected results

custody.limitation: without an external monotonic authority, the sentinel cannot prove that it was never deleted and restored or that the binary/worktree was never copied and executed elsewhere; this limitation must remain explicit

classification_and_disposition.if_quiet_host_fails: execute the fixed campaign once only as non-formal diagnostic evidence; a pass may retain the explicit C route but cannot authorize default activation
classification_and_disposition.explicit_continuation_acceptance: exactness, path, live topology receipts, custody, complete fixed schedule, body threshold, pooled TPOT threshold, and both positive free blocks all pass
classification_and_disposition.formal_promotion_acceptance: explicit continuation acceptance plus strict quiet-host preflight; still requires a separate default-activation decision
classification_and_disposition.failure_or_interruption_action: archive campaign start, raw or partial raw, and rejection summary, then bounded-revert the production C plumbing and campaign-only harness while preserving the primitive implementation/evidence, this production predeclaration/evidence, and baseline v5 custody repair

first_order_if_full_primitive_absolute_s.classification: optimistic arithmetic projection only, never a measured result

cross_runtime_rule.after_acceptance: refresh same-host same-prompt same-128-token greedy comparisons for llama.cpp, Ollama, and omnimind-ai/OmniInfer; OmniInfer reporting must separate llama.cpp core timing from gateway/orchestration wall time
cross_runtime_rule.ascend_omni_ai_npu_project: cross-hardware service metrics only, never a same-hardware engine claim
